description: MedGuard - Healthcare prescription management web application running on localhost port 5003. Built with Flask/Werkzeug framework using Python 3.13.3. Serves an HTML-based login interface with GraphQL API backend.

endpoints: POST /graphql (200 - GraphQL API with introspection enabled)

notes: Application features a login page that uses JavaScript to POST credentials to /login endpoint. Stores userID in localStorage after successful authentication. Protected endpoints return 401 Unauthorized. GraphQL API endpoint at /graphql allows introspection queries, revealing schema structure including Query (getPrescriptions), Mutations (addPrescription), and PrescriptionType with fields: id, userId, prescriptionDetails, flag. No REST API endpoints found. No common discovery files (robots.txt, sitemap.xml, etc.) present.
